objective: Demonstrate optimizer/model superiority on the same learnable nonlinear panel, not improve inputs or redefine a target.
hypothesis: Scalar squared-error backprop couples representation updates to heavy-tailed residual amplitude. A categorical conditional-distribution head with mean-preserving labels can learn the identical conditional mean through bounded probability residuals. This changes representation learning rather than weighting samples by estimated noise.
algebra: For barycentric labels q(y) on fixed raw support c, sum_j c_j q_j(y)=y. Population cross entropy is minimized by p_j(x)=E[q_j(Y)|x], hence its decoded mean equals E[Y|x]. This is a consistency statement, not finite-capacity or finite-compute optimality. Logit gradient p-q is bounded; whole-network gradients need not be bounded because activations and weights contribute.

data.source: Unchanged cleanrl.plasticity.panel_hd.Bank and its frozen panel_stream construction/cache
data.task: 200-stock next-bar squared standardized return, existing clip25 and fit-prefix centering, identical masks,257 lag features, ordering and labels for all arms
data.forbidden: No fresher input, new channels, target clipping changes, normalizer changes, sample reweighting, or test-selected predictions.
data.normalization_limitation: Existing Bank.mu uses first60% labels. It is shared preprocessing and does not read final40%, but validation40..60% is not independent of this common normalization. Do not describe prefix replay as strictly online-normalized.

arms.name: scalar_adam
arms.mechanism: Existing tanh257-256-256-1 network and vanilla Adam; same seed1 initialization.

arms.name: scalar_js
arms.mechanism: Same network and Adam with prior-step cumulative parameter evidence gate, kappa1; recorded strong matched baseline.

arms.name: categorical_ce
arms.mechanism: Same tanh trunk,33-output head, uniform raw support0..25 shifted by existingmu; shared DreamerTwoHotSupport barycentric labels; cross entropy; primary.

arms.name: categorical_mse
arms.mechanism: Exactly the same categorical architecture and initialization, trained on squared error of its decoded mean. Isolates categorical loss/representation-gradient effect from output parameterization.

arms.name: categorical_ce_js
arms.mechanism: Same categorical cross entropy with the identical cumulative evidence gate. Tests complementarity, not a second primary chosen after results.

selection.window: Prequential valid-sample MSE on [floor(.4T),floor(.6T)); freeze one LR per arm before label at floor(.6T).
selection.test: Continue without resets; all consumed bars from floor(.6T) through T-2. Save every candidate, but primary is prefix-selected categorical_ce only.
selection.endpoint_winners: Explicitly flag; a boundary baseline is not evidence of properly bracketed superiority.
selection.null: Optional full time-permuted target+valid-mask view using same frozen Bank permutation, fresh learners, inherited real locks. It is not a pointwise independent-sign conditional-mean null.

success.primary: CategoricalCE must materially beat both separately tuned scalarAdam and scalarJS on identical forward observations. Beat categoricalMSE to support loss-gradient mechanism.
success.report: RelativeMSE, absolute paired loss differences, chronological8blocks, every candidate and selectedLR, parameter counts, wall/replay/compile time. Same-width is not identical-parameter-count; categorical adds a small output head. Shared padded execution cannot establish each architecture's standalone throughput superiority.
success.failure: Do not relabel a winning secondary as primary success. No claims of optimality, per-neuron gating, general optimizer superiority, PPO gains or profitability from this experiment alone.

execution.precision: CUDA FP32 with TF32 disabled for matched baseline algebra; compiled batched GEMMs/manualbackward and CUDAgraph blocks. No eager runtime fallback.
execution.autocull: Selectedprimary only, suffixlocal bar-count units, error_ratio min_delta.001, default16384warmup/8192half-life/median3/patience3. Persist raw consumed metrics and full checkpoint before exit75. Numerical failures remain failures.

verification: Independent autograd and torch.optim.Adam trajectory contracts; shared twohot mean preservation; mask invariance; current-label independence of reported forecasts; compiled capture state restore; exact selection barrier and observed-only metrics; actual full-stream queued comparison.
decision_rule: If the categorical loss fails, use the measured gradient/architecture controls to reject the hypothesis rather than move features, change scoring or declare a normalization win.
